gen-audiowide-gf-ubuntu-sans: Audiowide sets its glyphs like spaced-out tiles, every stroke the same weight, with a futuristic hum. And Ubuntu Sans follows in sans-serif form, its big-eyed, tubular lowercase feeling like bent copper pipe beside that rigid heading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display lets its letters stay open and its x-height stand proud. Noto Sans Limbu follows in a tall-bodied sans with gaping curves, so a modest bump in body size may be plenty.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters widely and gives its strokes a soft thick-thin swing. But Noto Sans Old Turkic does the opposite job, offering chunky, tall lowercase with open-mouthed curves that stay clear.
gen-fs-bonny-archivo: Bonny brings a literary, refined serif, its lines tightly set and its strokes only mildly swelling. Then Archivo steps in as a plain sans with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, giving the page a firm footing under that finer heading.
gen-audiowide-gf-vend-sans: Rigid, tiled, unmistakably futuristic. Audiowide holds the top with wide-gapped glyphs while Vend Sans runs beneath in a ruler-drawn sans-serif line, its tall x-height filling every row and its terminals left wide open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-mende-: Ornate letters with a pronounced x-height lead here, all of them refusing to pinch shut in Almendra Display. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui then brings visible daylight through every curve, and that open, tall-standing lowercase is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya brings generous gaps in its curves and small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, a friendly sans for the text. Eater, dark and aggressive with its wide letter gaps and short ascenders, then supplies the menace above it.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-asap: Refined serif curves, pulled tight. Bonny leads with a mid-range stroke contrast, while Asap carries the text in a plain sans whose body height nearly matches its capitals, and that tall, readable build is what makes the pairing stand out.
gen-audiowide-gf-yaldevi: Audiowide is futuristic, with no pinched joins anywhere. It excels at striking tiled shapes, whereas Yaldevi is the one built for ease, its sans lowercase outsized and its e opening clearly to the right.
gen-eater-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch is approachable and contemporary, with a clearly open e and a compact gap between x-height and ascenders. Eater, dark and aggressive above it, keeps its hairlines neither wispy nor heavy, so the sans-serif body feels like a steadying hand.
